title: The sandbox dispatch door carries no harness: a cloud profile's runner rests on RUN_WORKER_HARNESS agreeing
body: a08 made the door carry and cross-check the model, but TICKS_HARNESS is still the deployment's RUN_WORKER_HARNESS (or the pi default), never the profile's runner. Today every cloud profile names pi so they agree; a profile naming another runner would record a harness that never ran. The same shape as a08 (a required field, booted as given, echoed in the handle, refused on mismatch) would close it.
